title: Shieldless SMP
description: Shieldless SMP make all shields removed from your inventory, and also makes them uncraftable for a shieldless server.
body: Shieldless SMP is a lightweight gameplay modifier designed to rebalance survival multiplayer combat. By removing the ability to hide behind a shield, this plugin encourages players to master movement, timing, and environmental awareness. Perfect for hardcore survival, competitive PvP, or "Old School" style SMPs.
